_notes: Every personal expense is a permission from the prior. E3 §3.4. Ease is the base chance before the prior's regard, the house budget, his temperament, and precedent. Costs are invented.

permissions.label: Books
permissions.blurb: The three volumes the library does not have.

line.granted: The prior signs for the books without looking up.
line.refused: The prior says the library has enough, and to use it.

permissions.label: A conference
permissions.blurb: Travel to a conference, three nights away.

line.granted: He asks who is covering the Hours, and signs.
line.refused: Not this year, he says; the house cannot spare the coverage or the money.

permissions.label: A private retreat
permissions.blurb: Eight days at a monastery, alone.

line.granted: He is glad you asked, and says so.
line.refused: He says the house's own retreat in Lent will have to do.

permissions.label: A car for the work
permissions.blurb: The use of a house car, or a second one bought.

line.granted: A used sedan appears in the lot with your name on a card on the dash.
line.refused: There are two cars for eleven men, he says, and a sign-out sheet.

permissions.label: A trip home
permissions.blurb: A parent is failing; a week at home.

line.granted: Go, he says, and stay as long as it takes.
line.refused: He asks whether it can wait until after the feast, and you hear yourself say yes.

permissions.label: A sabbatical
permissions.blurb: A semester away, to write or to rest.

line.granted: The council has agreed; the provincial's letter comes in a week.
line.refused: He lists the men who have not had one and asks where you would put yourself on the list.

permissions.label: To keep a gift
permissions.blurb: A parishioner's gift, kept rather than handed to the procurator.

line.granted: Keep it, he says, but do not mention it at table.
line.refused: It goes to the house, he says, as everything does, and thanks you for asking.

permissions.label: A better phone
permissions.blurb: The one the campus ministry actually needs.

line.granted: Signed, with a note to the procurator.
line.refused: The one you have makes calls, he says.
